name: Tempo Deadlift
instructions: Set up for a conventional deadlift.
Pull the bar off the floor over a slow 3-count, staying perfectly positioned.
Lock out, then lower over another 3-count.
The slow tempo builds positional strength and control.
longevityNotes: A strong hinge is back insurance. Learn it light, groove it often, and add load slowly — the goal is a back that never complains about picking things up.
overview: Tempo Deadlift is an intermediate hip-hinge exercise targeting the hamstrings, performed with a barbell. The hinge is the foundation of safe lifting — it teaches you to load the hips, not the spine.
